name: Johan Hendricks
headline: Senior Actuarial Analyst | Risk Modelling & Financial Forecasting | South African Actuarial Standards
summary: Results-driven Senior Actuarial Analyst with 11 years of experience in life, health, and pension risk modelling. Proven track record in building scalable actuarial models, improving accuracy, and driving regulatory compliance. Based in Polokwane, South Africa.

bullets: Built mortality models using SAS and R, improving life insurance claims accuracy by 18% across 200,000 policyholders (2020–2021).
Developed loss reserving models in Excel and Python, reducing reserve errors by 22% for a R1.2B portfolio.
Led actuarial validation of pension scheme projections using R and SQL, ensuring compliance with SARS guidelines.
Automated policy renewal risk assessments with Python scripts, cutting processing time by 40% for 15,000 policies annually.
Conducted stress testing on investment portfolios using Monte Carlo simulations in R, identifying 3 key risk scenarios with 95% confidence.
